description: T-4621: tabs First, S2, Last with First active. Which sheet's definition does a bare name in the body of a SHEET-scoped name added through the API (Graph names/add with a sheet) read: the name's own sheet's, or the first defining sheet by name (First < Last < S2, T-4587)? Row 1: SD scoped to S2, body =Dup; Dup on First (1) and S2 (7). Row 2: LD scoped to Last, body =DupB; DupB on First (2) and Last (90). Row 3: SW scoped to S2, body =DupC; DupC is a workbook name (First!B3, 3) and Last's (Last!B3, 93). Row 4: TW scoped to S2, body =DupD; DupD is a workbook name (First!B4, 4) and S2's (S2!B4, 74), Last's (Last!B4, 94). Row 5: control, workbook name WD body =Dup. Uses on other sheets are qualified (Sheet!Name); the own-sheet bare uses are column E.
